requirements.statement: A merchant can register their business on the platform

criteria.must: A signed-in user can submit a business registration with business name, country, currency and email
After registering, the merchant's status is pending

requirements.statement: A platform admin can review and approve or reject new merchant registrations

criteria.must: A platform admin can see a list of pending merchant registrations
A platform admin can approve a pending merchant, changing its status to approved
A platform admin can reject a pending merchant, changing its status to rejected

requirements.statement: A merchant can sign in securely to access their dashboard

criteria.must: A merchant can sign in via SSO and land on their dashboard

requirements.statement: A platform admin can sign in securely to access oversight tools

criteria.must: A platform admin can sign in via SSO and land on the admin console

requirements.statement: A merchant can create a payment request specifying an amount and currency

criteria.must: An approved merchant can create a payment request with an amount and currency
A newly created payment request appears in the merchant's list with pending status

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment request using mobile money

criteria.must: A customer can open a payment request and choose to pay by mobile money
A successful mobile money payment marks the payment request as paid

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment request using a card

criteria.must: A customer can open a payment request and choose to pay by card
A successful card payment marks the payment request as paid

requirements.statement: A merchant can view the status and history of their transactions

criteria.must: A merchant can view a list of their own transactions with each transaction's status

requirements.statement: A customer receives a confirmation after a successful payment

criteria.must: A customer sees a payment success confirmation immediately after a successful payment

requirements.statement: A merchant receives a notification when a payment is received

criteria.must: A merchant is notified when a payment against one of their payment requests succeeds

requirements.statement: A merchant can configure their payout bank account

criteria.must: A merchant can save a payout bank account with bank name, account number and account holder name

requirements.statement: A merchant can view their available balance and payout history

criteria.must: A merchant can view their current available balance
A merchant can view a history of their past payouts

requirements.statement: A merchant can request a payout of their available balance

criteria.must: A merchant can request a payout up to their available balance
A payout request for more than the available balance is refused

requirements.statement: A merchant can issue a refund to a customer for a completed payment

criteria.must: A merchant can issue a refund for one of their own completed transactions

requirements.statement: A platform admin can view all merchants' transactions and payouts across the platform

criteria.must: A platform admin can view transactions across every merchant
A platform admin can view payouts across every merchant

requirements.statement: A platform admin can review and act on disputed or failed transactions

criteria.must: A platform admin can view a list of disputed or failed transactions
A platform admin can resolve or reject a dispute
